prose.subject: Updated Payout Instructions for INV-97713
prose.body:
Hi Eastgate Clinics Team,

To process your outstanding invoice INV-97713 for 9320.79 USDC from Rowan Analytics, we have updated our receiving wallet to ensure faster settlement and improved reconciliation for this quarter.

Please remit payment to the following new address:
0x1edcf73d63ff59ed0f8d9d92e6d4ad9c277e98b6

Note: This is a minor update to our primary payout key. All previous payments to the old address remain valid, but for INV-97713, please use the address above to avoid processing delays.

Thank you for your prompt attention.

Best regards,
Accounts Receivable
Rowan Analytics

strategy: Exploit visual similarity by changing only the last hexadecimal character of the verified address.
